_note: 學習路徑內容建置第15批 #6／6：感官／使役被動（eng.t_adv.voice.causative-perception，學測級／高階）。使役動詞 make 與感官動詞 see/hear/watch 在主動時接『原形不定詞（不加 to）』：They made him wait.／I saw her leave.；但改成被動時，被省略的 to 會『回來』：He was made to wait.／She was seen to leave.。鐵律：主動 make/see sb do → 被動 be made/seen TO do。誘答以『被動缺 to／主動多加 to／用錯動詞形』鎖唯一正解。皆標準英語，經對抗式英語母語複核。音檔 edge-tts 童聲（prefix cps_）。

units.title_zh: 感官／使役被動（be made to / be seen to）
units.can_do: 我能處理使役動詞 make 與感官動詞 see/hear/watch 的主動與被動：主動時接原形不定詞（make him wait／see her leave），改成被動時要把省略的 to 補回來（be made to wait／be seen to leave）。
units.situation_group: 語態 使役／感官被動
units.subject: eng

claims.text: In the active, causative 'make' takes a bare infinitive (no 'to'): 'The teacher made us clean the room.'
claims.verification_ref: 主動使役 make 接原形不定詞（不加 to）；The teacher made us clean the room；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: In the passive, 'make' takes 'to' + infinitive: 'We were made to clean the room.' The 'to' that was dropped in the active comes back in the passive.
claims.verification_ref: 被動 make 接 to＋不定詞、省略的 to 回來；We were made to clean the room；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: Perception verbs (see, hear, watch) take a bare infinitive in the active: 'I saw him enter the house.'
claims.verification_ref: 感官動詞 see/hear/watch 主動接原形不定詞；I saw him enter the house；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: In the passive, perception verbs take 'to' + infinitive: 'He was seen to enter the house.'
claims.verification_ref: 感官動詞被動接 to＋不定詞；He was seen to enter the house；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

teach.body: The causative verb 'make' (= force someone to do something) takes the bare infinitive (no 'to') in the active voice: The teacher made us clean the room. After 'made' we use the base form 'clean', not 'to clean'.
teach.zh_hint: 使役動詞 make（強迫、使）在主動時，後面接『原形不定詞』（不加 to）：The teacher made us clean the room.（老師要我們打掃教室。）made 後面是原形 clean，不是 to clean。

teach.body: The teacher made us clean the room.
teach.zh_hint: 老師要我們打掃教室。主動 make＋原形 clean。

teach.body: In the passive, the 'to' that was left out comes back: We were made to clean the room. The passive pattern is 'be made TO + base form', and this 'to' must appear.
teach.zh_hint: 但改成被動時，本來省略的 to 要『補回來』：We were made to clean the room.（我們被要求打掃教室。）被動是 be made TO＋原形——這個 to 一定要出現。

teach.body: We were made to clean the room.
teach.zh_hint: 我們被要求打掃教室。被動 be made to＋原形。

teach.body: Perception verbs 'see', 'hear' and 'watch' work the same way: active takes the base form (I saw him enter.), and in the passive the 'to' returns (He was seen to enter.). Remember: active 'make/see somebody do' becomes passive 'be made/seen TO do'.
teach.zh_hint: 感官動詞 see／hear／watch 也一樣：主動接原形（I saw him enter.），被動時 to 回來（He was seen to enter.）。口訣：主動 make/see sb do → 被動 be made/seen TO do。

teach.body: He was seen to enter the house.
teach.zh_hint: 有人看到他進了屋子。被動 be seen to＋原形。

practice.stem: 選正確：The students were made ____ the classroom after school.（學生放學後被要求打掃教室）

distractor_rationales.clean: 被動 be made 後面要把 to 補回來：were made to clean；原形 clean 是主動才用。
distractor_rationales.cleaning: 被動使役用 to＋原形，不用動名詞：to clean。
distractor_rationales.cleaned: 被動使役用 to＋原形，不用過去分詞：to clean。

practice.feedback: 被動 make 要補 to：were made to clean。

practice.stem: 選正確：The coach made the players ____ for two hours.（教練讓球員練習兩小時）

distractor_rationales.to practice: 主動使役 make sb do 接原形不加 to：made the players practice。
distractor_rationales.practicing: 主動使役後面接原形，不用動名詞：practice。
distractor_rationales.practiced: 主動使役後面接原形，不用過去分詞：practice。

practice.feedback: 主動 make 接原形：made the players practice。

practice.stem: 主動 'People saw her leave.' 改成被動，選正確：She was seen ____ the building.

distractor_rationales.leave: 感官動詞被動要把 to 補回來：was seen to leave；原形 leave 是主動才用。
distractor_rationales.left: 這裡要原形不定詞；left 是過去式／過去分詞，不用在 be seen to＋原形。
distractor_rationales.to left: to 後面要接原形 leave，不是 left：to leave。

practice.feedback: 被動感官動詞要補 to：was seen to leave。

practice.stem: 主動 'The teacher made us stay.' 的被動哪個正確？

被動要把 to 補回來：were made to stay。
被動使役用 to＋原形，不用動名詞：to stay。
be 動詞後面要用過去分詞 made，不是原形 make。

practice.feedback: 被動 be made to＋原形：We were made to stay。

practice.stem: 關於使役 make，下面哪一句正確？

被動要把 to 補回來：was made to apologize。
主動使役 make 接原形不加 to：made him wait。
主動使役 make 接原形不加 to：made him apologize。

practice.feedback: 被動補 to、主動不加 to：He was made to apologize。

practice.stem: 聽音檔，把整句寫下來（聽寫）。
practice.answer: The children were made to wait outside.
practice.feedback: 對照答案自評：were made to wait（被動補回 to）有沒有寫對、句點有沒有漏。

units.selfeval_note: 翻看答案自己判斷（不自動判讀）；選完進入 SRS 間隔複習。

shadowing.note: 跟著讀＋語調模仿：播音檔→跟著讀→自評（不自動判發音）。主動原形、被動的 to 要清楚唸出來、句尾下收。

lines.text: They made him wait for an hour.
lines.intonation: They made him wait 起、for an hour 句尾下收

lines.text: She was made to say sorry.
lines.intonation: She was made to say 起、sorry 句尾下收
